filename: Using Contrastive Learning to Identify Structural Deficiencies in Climate Models and Generate Calibrated Physics Ensembles.pdf
title: Using Contrastive Learning to Identify Structural Deficiencies in Climate Models and Generate Calibrated Physics Ensembles
testbed_rationale: The presentation describes perturbed parameter ensembles generated with CAM6 coupled to TAU-ML and KK2000 microphysics, but does not provide direct access links or repository locations for the datasets.
pain_points: Warm rain microphysics remains highly uncertain in global models
Significant zonal mean climatology biases across multiple regions and variables simultaneously
Drizzle frequency bias and extreme precipitation biases in climate simulations
High dimensionality of physical feature space complicates parameter sensitivity and attribution analysis
extraction_notes: Document consists of presentation slides without formal publication metadata (no publication year, venue, or explicit data/code links). Cites literature through 2024 (Eidhammer et al. 2024).
